en.subtitle: AI Operations & Automation Specialist | Python · JavaScript · REST APIs | Workflow Automation | Professional English
en.summary: Automation-minded engineer who starts from the process, not the tool: I map how a workflow runs, find the repetitive steps and manual error points, then build the smallest automation that removes them. Delivered a web tool that cut a 5-person team's data-entry time by 70% at Groupe Chimique Tunisien, a Python data-harvesting pipeline (scraping, cleaning, structured reporting), and a Chrome extension that fills application forms automatically. I use AI assistants daily for research, structuring information and code review, validating every output against real data. Professional English; on-site ready in Sousse.

skills.items: Process analysis and requirements gathering, documentation of procedures, data management and operational reporting, order/billing workflows, prioritisation of manual and error-prone tasks.

Python, JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js scripting; Python automation (Selenium, BeautifulSoup, Scrapy, Pandas); Chrome MV3 extension automation; REST API and JSON/webhook integration; prompt design for structured AI outputs and human validation of results; Git.
Excel (formulas, lookups, data validation, structured reporting), CSV/JSON extraction and cleaning, SQL/PostgreSQL, MongoDB, data consistency checks.
Workflow testing and error handling, post-deployment monitoring, operating instructions and troubleshooting procedures, measurement of time saved and errors reduced.
English (professional, daily working language with international clients), French (fluent), Arabic (native).
